notes.title: Beer Onsen Resort: 07/12 Standard Update
notes.notes:
📰 Daily Summary Panel
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602789/028709e74642ff08b68c316dc722a8078112606e.png"]

Introducing a brand-new Daily Summary Panel—get an at-a-glance overview of your resort’s key metrics every morning. Track income, resource consumption, best seller brew, and more in one convenient dashboard.
🎰 Gacha Animation Overhaul
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602789/956024402e1807a671d1f22d00a68115c0982d31.png"]

We’ve given our gacha draws a facelift! Enjoy smoother transitions, snappier effects, and a more satisfying “cha-ching” moment when rare ingredients pop up.
🌳 Research Tree Expansion
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602789/7a8f63b8c009a270e0498beacaa634df04c68ce1.png"]
Venture deeper into the realm with the Research Tree. Unlock advanced recipes, new upgrades as you progress through each branching path.
🐞 Critical Bug Fix
Squashed a dangerous bug that was resetting tutorial progress every other session. Your hard-earned tutorial milestones are now safe and sound!

notes.title: Beer Onsen Resort - Latest Update! 🍻✨
notes.notes:
New Features:
Gacha Machine UI Revamp: A fresh new design for a better visual experience.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602789/f937f653aa32412624ef3e3a44ba02b9ba49b465.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602789/ddc5a85ae0cca379c0aed6e33615e6a0597efd9f.png"]

Date Display: The game now features a date display, enhancing immersion.

More Tutorials: Added additional tutorials to guide new players through the brewing process.

Encyclopedia Page: A comprehensive new page to check detailed information about all the drinks and ingredients.

Ingredient Detail Screen: Click on ingredients to view detailed descriptions and properties.

New Pop-up Panel: After brewing a new beer, a pop-up panel will automatically display with details of your creation.

Fixes:
Localization Issues: Resolved language display issues for a smoother experience worldwide.

Tutorial Bugs: Fixed bugs in the tutorial for a quicker, smoother onboarding process.
